**Finding: deviation (high severity, assignment)** — Section 15 (¶p0080).

**What the document says:** A flat mutual consent requirement with only a narrow "financially responsible affiliate" exception, and no reasonableness qualifier on consent.

**Why it deviates from the playbook:**
- No successor/M&A carve-out for us — a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of Mortgage Logic.com's assets would need TrueLink's consent.
- Consent is unqualified, so TrueLink could withhold arbitrarily.
- No bar on TrueLink assigning to one of our competitors.
- Good news: there is no change-of-control language anywhere in the agreement, so TrueLink has no termination or re-pricing right on our change of control — this is not a walk-away.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** Section 15 now permits Client assignment without consent to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of substantially all assets; keeps TrueLink's assignment subject to our consent, not unreasonably withheld, and never to a competitor of ours; and confirms a Client change of control is not an assignment and gives TrueLink no termination, suspension or re-pricing right.

**Fallback offered in the comment:** mutual successor-assignment right on written notice, with consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld.
